POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Power Mechanics workshop layout, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Mechanics workshop layout.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Mechanics workshop layout.

3. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

4. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

7. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.

8. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

11. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

12. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

14. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.

15. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.

16. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
